# Accessibility Standards for Muse

## WCAG 2.2 Quick Reference (AA Level)

### Perceivable
| Criterion | Summary |
|-----------|---------|
| 1.1.1 Non-text Content | All non-text content has a text alternative. Decorative images use `alt=""`. |
| 1.2.1 Audio/Video-only | Provide transcript (audio) or text alternative (video). |
| 1.2.2 Captions (Prerecorded) | All prerecorded video has synchronized captions. |
| 1.3.1 Info and Relationships | Structure (headings, lists, tables, labels, landmarks) programmatically conveyed. |
| 1.3.2 Meaningful Sequence | Visual and programmatic ordering should align. |
| 1.3.4 Orientation | Content not restricted to single orientation unless essential. |
| 1.3.5 Identify Input Purpose | Input fields have `autocomplete` attributes. |
| 1.4.1 Use of Color | Color is not the only means of conveying info. |
| 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum) | Text: 4.5:1 normal, 3:1 large (18pt / 14pt bold). |
| 1.4.4 Resize Text | Text resizable to 200% without loss of content. |
| 1.4.10 Reflow | Content fits within 320px width without 2D scroll. |
| 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast | UI components and graphics: 3:1 against adjacent colors. |
| 1.4.13 Content on Hover/Focus | Popup content is dismissible, hoverable, persistent. |

### Operable
| Criterion | Summary |
|-----------|---------|
| 2.1.1 Keyboard | All functionality operable via keyboard. |
| 2.1.2 No Keyboard Trap | User can navigate away from any component using keyboard. |
| 2.4.1 Bypass Blocks | Skip link to bypass repeated navigation. |
| 2.4.2 Page Titled | Pages have descriptive `<title>`. |
| 2.4.3 Focus Order | Focus order preserves meaning and operability. |
| 2.4.4 Link Purpose | Link purpose determinable from text or context. |
| 2.4.6 Headings and Labels | Headings and labels describe topic or purpose. |
| 2.4.7 Focus Visible | Keyboard focus indicator is visible. |
| 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured | Focused element not hidden by sticky headers/footers. |
| 2.5.1 Pointer Gestures | Multi-point gestures have single-pointer alternative. |
| 2.5.7 Dragging Movements | Drag-and-drop has click/tap alternative. |
| 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum) | Interactive controls at least 24x24 CSS px. |

### Understandable
| Criterion | Summary |
|-----------|---------|
| 3.1.1 Language of Page | `<html lang="...">` set correctly. |
| 3.2.1 On Focus | Focus doesn't trigger unexpected context change. |
| 3.3.1 Error Identification | Errors described to user in text. |
| 3.3.2 Labels or Instructions | Labels or instructions provided for user input. |
| 3.3.3 Error Suggestion | Suggest corrections for detected errors. |
| 3.3.8 Accessible Authentication | No cognitive function test. Allow paste and autofill. |

### Robust
| Criterion | Summary |
|-----------|---------|
| 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value | All UI components have accessible name, role, and state. |
| 4.1.3 Status Messages | Status messages announced by screen readers without focus. |

## Five Rules of ARIA
1. **Prefer native HTML** — Use `<button>` not `<div role="button">`.
2. **Don't change native semantics** — Don't add `role="heading"` to a `<button>`.
3. **All ARIA controls must be keyboard operable** — Handle Enter and Space key events.
4. **Don't use `aria-hidden="true"` on focusable elements**.
5. **All interactive elements need an accessible name**.

## Muse-Specific Patterns

### Glassmorphism & Contrast
- Glassmorphism effects (backdrop-filter, transparency) must NOT reduce text contrast below 4.5:1
- Ensure glass panels have sufficient opacity for readability
- Test all glass surfaces with light and dark mode

### Music Player Accessibility
- Player controls must have `aria-label` (e.g., "Play", "Pause", "Next track")
- Volume slider must use `role="slider"` with `aria-valuemin`, `aria-valuemax`, `aria-valuenow`
- Seek bar must be keyboard operable (arrow keys)
- Now-playing info must be announced on track change (live region)
- Queue items must be focusable and operable by keyboard

### Visualizer Accessibility
- Provide a text alternative describing the visualization
- Allow users to disable animations (`prefers-reduced-motion`)
- Ensure controls work with keyboard only

### RTL + A11y
- Persian screen readers need proper `lang="fa"` and `dir="rtl"`
- Mixed LTR/RTL content needs explicit `dir` on spans
- Ensure logical focus order works in RTL mode

## Anti-Patterns

### Vue-Specific
| Anti-pattern | Fix |
|-------------|-----|
| `@click` on `<div>` without role/keyboard | Use `<button>` or add `role`, `tabindex`, `@keydown` |
| `v-if` toggle without focus management | Focus first element after toggle via `nextTick` |
| `v-html` with untrusted content | Sanitize with DOMPurify first |

### Keyboard & Focus
| Anti-pattern | Severity |
|-------------|----------|
| `onClick` without `onKeyDown` on non-native elements | CRITICAL |
| Positive `tabindex` values (>0) | CRITICAL |
| Focus trap without Escape | CRITICAL |
| Missing skip link | IMPORTANT |
| `outline: none` without `:focus-visible` replacement | CRITICAL |

### Color & Visual
| Anti-pattern | Severity |
|-------------|----------|
| Text contrast below 4.5:1 (normal) / 3:1 (large) | CRITICAL |
| Information conveyed by color alone | CRITICAL |
| Fixed font sizes preventing resize | IMPORTANT |
| Content not reflowing at 320px | IMPORTANT |
| Animation without `prefers-reduced-motion` | SUGGESTION |

## Accessibility Checklist

### Perceivable
- [ ] All images have appropriate alt text
- [ ] Page uses semantic landmarks: `<header>`, `<nav>`, `<main>`, `<footer>`
- [ ] Headings follow logical hierarchy (h1 > h2 > h3, no gaps)
- [ ] Text contrast meets 4.5:1 (normal) / 3:1 (large)
- [ ] Glassmorphism elements maintain sufficient contrast
- [ ] Content reflows at 320px without horizontal scroll
- [ ] `<html lang="fa">` or `<html lang="en">` set correctly
- [ ] Text resizable to 200% without loss of content

### Operable
- [ ] All functionality accessible via keyboard
- [ ] No keyboard traps (Escape closes overlays)
- [ ] Skip link provided as first focusable element
- [ ] Focus indicator visible on all interactive elements
- [ ] Focus order matches visual order
- [ ] Touch targets at least 24x24 CSS px
- [ ] Animations respect `prefers-reduced-motion`
- [ ] Music player controls work with keyboard

### Understandable
- [ ] All form inputs have associated `<label>` or `aria-label`
- [ ] Error messages linked to inputs via `aria-describedby`
- [ ] Required fields indicated with `required` or `aria-required`

### Robust
- [ ] All interactive elements have accessible name, role, and state
- [ ] No `aria-hidden="true"` on focusable elements
- [ ] Dynamic content announced via live regions
- [ ] SPA route changes announced to screen readers (use `useTitle()` or route announcer)
